title: Reinsurance programs
text:
Reinsurance programs

Validation rules for fields related to reinsurance programs.

Reinsurance Program Manager

| Field | Description | Validation Rules | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Program Name | Name of this reinsurance program | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record Can contain up to 100 characters | |
| Associated Exposures | Exposure view or views associated with this reinsurance program | Can contain one or more existing exposure views | |
| Number of Treaties | Number of treaties in this reinsurance program | Read-only | |
| Surplus Share Count | Number of surplus share treaties in this reinsurance program | Read-only | |
| Quota Share Count | Number of quota share treaties in this reinsurance program | Read-only | |
| Per Risk XOL Count | Number of per risk XOL treaties in this reinsurance program | Read only | |
| CAT XOL Count | Number of CAT XOL treaties in this reinsurance program | Read-only | |
| Modified Date | Date on which this reinsurance program was last modified | Read-only | |
| Description | Description of this reinsurance program, such as the import path for this
 program | Optional Can contain up to 1024 characters | |
